reason: The hypothesis directly combines the finding that Pd additions and annealing narrow the exchange energy distribution and enhance refrigerant capacity (P2, P7) with the mechanism of magnetically driven spinodal decomposition producing soft magnetic nanodomains (P13). It proposes that this specific nanostructuring simultaneously optimizes magnetocaloric response, thermal exchange, and mechanical robustness, which is a synthesis of two separate papers but does not introduce a new mechanism or resolve a conflict beyond what those papers individually suggest.
copied_elements: heat treatment and Pd additions reduce distribution of exchange energies (P2, P7)
magnetically driven spinodal decomposition forms soft ferromagnetic nanodomains (P13)
enhanced refrigerant capacity (~40%) with Pd (P2, P7)
coherent nanodomains minimize domain wall pinning (P13, P14, P17)
